text: Behind Washington in this famous painting, a soldier raises the Stars and Stripes. But the crossing was in December seventeen seventy-six. Only on June fourteenth, seventeen seventy-seven, did the Continental Congress resolve that the flag would have thirteen stripes and thirteen stars. Which flag was carried that night, if any, is not known.

phonemes: bᵻhˌaɪnd wˈɑːʃɪŋtən ɪn ðɪs fˈeɪməs pˈeɪntɪŋ, ɐ sˈoʊldʒɚ ɹˈeɪzᵻz ðə stˈɑːɹz ænd stɹˈaɪps. bˌʌt ðə kɹˈɔsɪŋ wʌz ɪn dᵻsˈɛmbɚ sˈɛvəntˌiːn sˈɛvəntisˈɪks. ˈoʊnli ˌɔn dʒˈuːn fˈɔːɹtiːnθ, sˈɛvəntˌiːn sˈɛvəntisˈɛvən, dˈɪd ðə kˌɑːntɪnˈɛntəl kˈɑːŋɡɹəs ɹᵻzˈɑːlv ðætðə flˈæɡ wʊdhɐv θˈɜːtiːn stɹˈaɪps ænd θˈɜːtiːn stˈɑːɹz. wˌɪtʃ flˈæɡ wʌz kˈæɹid ðæt nˈaɪt, ɪf ˌɛni, ɪz nˌɑːt nˈoʊn.
